sources.title: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct is Liquid AI's flagship instruction-tuned model, delivering exceptional performance for chat, instruction-following, and tool-calling tasks. Built on the LFM2.5 architecture with extended pre-training and reinforcement learning.

sources.title: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct MLX 4bit — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact, efficient model that punches at a reasonable level for its tiny footprint. At 1.2B parameters, it handles straightforward instruction-following and conversational tasks with decent coherence, though it will struggle with complex reasoning or nuanced multi-step problems. The MLX 4-bit quantization makes it particularly suited for running locally on Apple Silicon with minimal memory ...
